text: At its meeting on April 16, 2025, the Toronto Transit Commission Board considered the report titled "Audit of the Toronto Transit Commission’s Non-Union Workforce Planning and Management" and has forwarded the report to City Council through the Audit Committee.
City Council on July 23 and 24, 2025, adopted the following: 1. City Council receive the report (March 10, 2025) from the Auditor General for information.
